headline: 10 lesser-known Indian stocks offer dividend yields up to 19% in FY26
hook: High-yield dividend picks beyond the bluechips

modes.bear: Extraordinarily high dividend yields in small-cap stocks can sometimes accompany low liquidity and weak underlying growth.
modes.bull: High yields offer attractive cash returns for income-focused portfolios beyond standard large-cap dividend payers.
modes.simple: Some smaller companies pay out a large share of profits as dividends, offering extra cash for shareholders, but they carry higher stock price risks.

summary: LiveMint has highlighted ten lesser-known Indian listed companies offering substantial dividend yields for FY26. CyberTech Systems leads the list with a yield of 19.6%, followed by Majestic Auto at 16.4% and Jagran Prakashan at 16.1%. Other notable names include IL&FS Investment Managers at 15.9% and Premco Global at 11.2%. For Indian retail investors, high dividend yields can provide steady income, though low liquidity in smaller-cap stocks warrants careful consideration.
why_it_matters: Higher income potential from lesser-known small-cap stock holdings.
winners_losers: Dividend-seeking investors gain / liquidity-constrained traders cautious
